title: First working day and insurance start date
purpose: Ask for the first working day (the contractual start date) and derive the pension fund insurance start date from it, using the latest date.

stories.title: Employee confirms the first working day
stories.i_want: to enter and confirm my first working day myself in the onboarding questionnaire
stories.so_that: HR and the pension fund work with my actual start date, even when it has moved since the contract was signed (for example because I negotiated an earlier exit with my old employer)
stories.priority_reason: HR calls the first working day the 'number one' item; it moves often and a stale date led to a wrong registration at the pension fund that took weeks to fix (F-hr_transcript-872bd7, F-hr_transcript-e3721e, F-hr_transcript-e18e66).

acceptance_criteria.title: First working day is always asked and required
acceptance_criteria.given: any new employee fills in the onboarding questionnaire, whatever their residence, nationality or civil status
acceptance_criteria.when: the employee reaches the employment start step
acceptance_criteria.then: the employee is asked for their first working day, and the questionnaire cannot be submitted without it

examples.name: Mid-month start, as in Julia's case (hr_transcript/F-hr_transcript-e18e66)
Start on the 1st of a month

acceptance_criteria.title: The date entered is the contractual start date
acceptance_criteria.given: the employee's contract states a start date that falls on a weekend or a public holiday
acceptance_criteria.when: the employee enters the first working day
acceptance_criteria.then: the employee is asked for, and enters, the contractual start date as the first working day, even though no work is done that day; the date is given as DD.MM.YYYY. Assumption (D-039), to be verified by a domain expert: the first working day is the contractual start date, even on a weekend or public holiday.

examples.name: Contract starts on Saturday 1 August (Swiss National Day)

acceptance_criteria.title: Who receives the first working day
acceptance_criteria.given: the employee has submitted the questionnaire with a first working day
acceptance_criteria.then: the first working day is recorded for HR (so HR knows when the employee starts) and serves as the basis for the pension fund's insurance start date; how it is sent to the parties is a separate topic

acceptance_criteria.title: After submission only HR changes the first working day
acceptance_criteria.given: the employee has submitted the questionnaire
acceptance_criteria.when: the first working day moves later on
acceptance_criteria.then: the employee can no longer change it in the questionnaire; only HR changes it, the latest date always counts and no history of earlier dates is kept. How HR makes the change belongs to the later HR-side spec (see OQ-hr-side-follow-ups).

stories.title: Derive the pension insurance start date from the first working day
stories.i_want: to receive an insurance start date on the 1st of a month that is derived from the employee's first working day
stories.so_that: the employee is registered with the correct insurance start without the employee having to know the fund's rule
stories.priority_reason: The insurance start date is a required field of the pension fund registration; a wrong date caused an unfriendly letter from the fund and weeks of fixing (F-pension_portal-509cbe, F-hr_transcript-e18e66).

acceptance_criteria.title: The insurance start date is derived, not asked
acceptance_criteria.given: the employee has entered a first working day
acceptance_criteria.then: the employee is not asked for an insurance start date; Lonio derives it from the first working day only and records it for the pension fund as a date DD.MM.YYYY on the 1st of a month

acceptance_criteria.title: Start on the 1st of a month: insurance starts the same day
acceptance_criteria.given: the first working day is the 1st of a month
acceptance_criteria.when: the insurance start date is derived
acceptance_criteria.then: the insurance start date is the first working day itself

examples.name: Contractual start on Saturday 1 August (public holiday)

acceptance_criteria.title: Start on any other day: insurance starts on the 1st of the following month
acceptance_criteria.given: the first working day is not the 1st of a month
acceptance_criteria.when: the insurance start date is derived
acceptance_criteria.then: the insurance start date is the 1st of the month after the first working day, also across a year end

examples.name: Start on the 2nd of a month
Start on the last day of the year

acceptance_criteria.title: Weekend or holiday does not shift the insurance start
acceptance_criteria.given: the contractual first working day falls on a weekend or public holiday
acceptance_criteria.when: the insurance start date is derived
acceptance_criteria.then: the derivation uses the contractual date as entered, not the next day actually worked. Assumption (D-039), to be verified by a domain expert.

stories.title: Re-derive the insurance start date when the first working day moves
stories.i_want: the insurance start date to always follow the latest first working day
stories.so_that: a moved start date never leaves a wrong insurance start date at the pension fund, as happened with Julia
stories.priority_reason: A missed update after Julia's start date moved caused a wrong date at the fund, an unfriendly letter and weeks of fixing (F-hr_transcript-e18e66).

acceptance_criteria.title: Employee changes the date before submission
acceptance_criteria.given: the employee has entered a first working day and then changes it before submitting
acceptance_criteria.then: the insurance start date is derived from the latest first working day only; the earlier date is not kept

examples.name: Moved from 01.04 to 15.03, as Julia did (hr_transcript/F-hr_transcript-e18e66)
Moved from 15.03 to 01.03 (earlier exit from old employer)

acceptance_criteria.title: HR changes the date after submission
acceptance_criteria.given: the questionnaire has been submitted and HR later changes the first working day
acceptance_criteria.then: the insurance start date is derived again from the new first working day, the latest date always counts and no history of earlier dates is kept. How HR enters the change and how the fund is notified are specified later (see OQ-hr-side-follow-ups).

examples.name: HR moves the start from 15.03 to 01.05
HR moves the start from 01.05 to 20.04
